source: test/e2e/family-access.spec.mjs (committed), Chromium 1.64.1 headless with SwiftShader, reduced motion
mode: family access on in-process servers bound to 127.0.0.1 with in-memory databases, empty provider keys, simulated payments; each person a separate browser context with its own Chromium virtual authenticator (CDP WebAuthn)
limits: Test captures of synthetic people and households, not real family use. The virtual authenticator is not a real device, Touch ID, Face ID or security key. Images showing invitation links were deliberately not committed.
